Basemap: Protomaps 4.15.2, OpenStreetMap snapshot 2026-09-21. Ukraine region from Geofabrik, zoom 0-11. Roads, settlements, labels and generalized geography, omitting landuse and building layers; additional details loaded online. Data is an ODbL Produced Work.
